Subject: Acme + Redwood: SOC 2 / Audit logs recap & next steps

Hi John + Jane,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the candid discussion. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

High-level pain points you shared
- Regulatory requirement for SSAE/SOC 2 evidence and clear audit logs for customer actions
- Must-document data retention policy and ability to configure retention windows per environment
- Procurement needs a DPA and pen-test evidence to complete security review
- Concern about multi-tenant data isolation and encryption-in-transit/at-rest for PII

Goals we heard
- Get SOC 2 artifacts + pen test summary to your security team this week
- Confirm default audit log retention and options for extended retention or exporting logs to your SIEM
- Share DPA draft for your legal to review; aim to close before the POC start (target: end of month)
- Align on a 6-8 week technical POC with clear success criteria (throughput, latency, auditability)

What I attached/linked
- redwood_soc2_summary_v1.pdf (SOC 2 Type II summary + controls matrix) — attached
- pen_test_evidence_stub.txt (high-level pen test summary; full report available under NDA) — attached
- DPA draft link: https://drive.google.com/acme/soc2-evidence (DPA draft + evidence pack)

Technical notes (Dev & Rishi included)
- Audit logs: default retention is 90 days for hosted accounts; we can configure longer retention or set up continuous export (S3/Syslog) for your SIEM.
- Encryption: TLS1.2+ in-transit; AES-256 at-rest. Customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) available in Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Pen testing: we run annual external pentests; summary attached. Full redacted report possible with NDA.

Proposed next steps (owners + target dates)
1) Marissa: Share the SOC 2 summary and pen test stub — done (attached) — 7/15
2) John/Jane: Share procurement/legal contact and any required contract templates — by 7/17
3) Dev Patel (cc): Follow up on audit log export options and sample log schema — by 7/17
4) Rishi Malhotra (cc): Share POC pricing and Dedicated/private deployment options for compliance use cases — by 7/17
5) Schedule 30-min procurement/legal + security call to review DPA redline & evidence — propose 7/22 or 7/23

If that all looks right, I'll share the DPA draft and a short slide (1-pager) on the POC scope to align stakeholders.

Thanks again — happy to hop on another call if you want a walkthrough of the SOC2 matrix.

Best,
Marissa Cole

John — great questions. Responses below and I've attached the items you asked for.

> Can you confirm the full pen test report can be provided under NDA and whether it includes external exploitable findings vs. internal-only findings?
Yes — we can provide the full pen test report under NDA. The attached pen_test_evidence_stub.txt summarizes the scope and high-level findings (no exploitable external criticals in the last cycle). Full report includes both external and internal findings; redacted PII and customer data. We'll get the legal/NDA process started if you want the full PDF.

> What is the granularity of the audit logs?
Short answer: the exported schema includes timestamp, actor (user/service principal), action type, resource id, request id, response code, and source IP. I've attached a sample log line (json) as well to the shared Drive link. Dev, I put you on action to share the schema sample and a brief export config doc to John's SIEM team.

> Retention and Dedicated/Private requirements
Default hosted retention: 90 days. Options:
- Extend retention to 13 months via configurable archival to your S3 bucket (supported on Hosted with export configuration)
- Dedicated/Private gives you more control and customer-managed KMS, but most customers achieve 13-month retention via export and lifecycle rules to a customer S3.

DPA draft: attached as redwood_dpa_draft_2026-07-15.docx and shared to the Drive link. Please have legal take a first pass; we're typically flexible on standard mutual indemnities for SOC2-backed services.

Attachments included / links
- redwood_soc2_summary_v1.pdf (SOC 2 Type II controls matrix)
- pen_test_evidence_stub.txt (summary)
- redwood_dpa_draft_2026-07-15.docx (DPA draft)
- https://drive.google.com/acme/soc2-evidence (sample log line + evidence pack)

Proposed next step: 30-min procurement/legal + security call to review the DPA and evidence. We can do 7/22 at 10:00am PT — is that OK for you? I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Owners recap
- Marissa: coordinate DPA redline and evidence share (me)
- Dev Patel: technical log schema and export config (dev_patel@redwood.inference.com)
- Rishi Malhotra: POC pricing + deployment options (rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference.com)

Thanks — I'll start the NDA flow if you want the full pentest PDF.

Best,
Marissa
